_comment: Normalized argv from review_gate._run_review for a first push of ≤15 files (Kimchi port, C2 + A6: --approve for skill discovery in the untrusted clone). Scenarios 13 and 20 compare byte-for-byte after normalisation. Normalised: claude executable → '<claude>', plugin root (_PLUGIN_ROOT) → '<plugin-dir>', deny extension path (_DENY_EXT) → '<deny-ext>', push range in prompt → '<RANGE>'.
